scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:functions
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json package-lock.json firebase.json firestore.indexes.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts vitest.security.config.ts vitest.integration.config.ts eslint.config.js prettier.config.js README.md "packages/shared/**/*.{json,ts}" "functions/**/*.{json,ts}" "scripts/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "docs/implementation-evidence/*.md" ".github/workflows/*.yml"
scripts.test:security: firebase emulators:exec --project stockmok --only firestore "npm run test:security:inner"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project stockmok --only firestore "npm run test:rules:inner"
scripts.test:backend: firebase emulators:exec --project stockmok --only firestore "npm run test:backend:inner"
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --project stockmok --only firestore "npm run test:integration:inner"

scripts.verify:security: npm run verify && npm run test:security

scripts.test:bootstrap:replay: firebase emulators:exec --project stockmok --only auth,firestore "npm run test:bootstrap:replay:inner"
